explanation: The theorem is a specialized CFSG lemma. P is a p-group with Frattini quotient of order p², p ≠ 2, and H₁, H₂ normalize P. The commutator ⁅H₁,H₂⁆ is a 2-group that does not centralize P. The conclusion is P = ⁅⁅H₁,H₂⁆,P⁆. I checked Mathlib's Frattini file (Mathlib/GroupTheory/Frattini.lean) and the Sylow file, the only GroupTheory files that mention the Frattini subgroup. They contain only general facts such as the Frattini argument and non-generation. I found nothing about coprime action on a p-group with a rank-2 Frattini quotient, and no commutator factorization statement of this kind. The proof relies on library-specific lemmas, so it is not a one- or two-line consequence of a single Mathlib declaration.
